purpose: Describe another person’s observable wish to act.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
ます-stem + たがる / たがっている.
My younger brother wants to play outside.
The children want to play the new game.
The dog wants to come inside.
formation: ます-stem + たがる / たがっている.
restrictions: Reports behavior or signs of wanting rather than directly quoting the person’s inner wish.
mistake: Use たい for an ordinary statement of your own desire.
